nodes.name: Create Nexus Run
nodes.notes: Creates the durable Nexus run that n8n will advance.

nodes.name: 01 Start research
nodes.notes: Research the topic deeply. Produce a master brief covering: core insight, key facts, audience for each platform (LinkedIn=professional, X=technical/punchy, Instagram=visual/human), CTA options, 3–5 universal themes, and image concept.

nodes.name: Complete research
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 02 Start write_linkedin
nodes.notes: Write a LinkedIn post based on the research brief. Format: hook → body (3–5 paragraphs) → CTA → hashtags (3–5). Max 3000 chars. Tone: professional, insightful, human.

nodes.name: Complete write_linkedin
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 03 Start write_x
nodes.notes: Adapt the LinkedIn content for X. Either a single punchy tweet (≤280 chars) or a thread (3–8 tweets). Lead with the sharpest insight. Hashtags: max 2–3 at the end of the last tweet only.

nodes.name: Complete write_x
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 04 Start write_instagram
nodes.notes: Write an Instagram caption. Hook → story/insight → CTA → hashtag block (10–20). Max 2200 chars. Tone: authentic and visual-first. image_url must be set in the issue for the publish step.

nodes.name: Complete write_instagram
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 05 Start review
nodes.notes: Review all three posts together for: character limits, tone consistency, cross-platform coherence, hashtag counts, no unverified claims. Approve all or request specific changes per platform.

nodes.name: Complete review
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Route route_review
nodes.notes: Evaluates Nexus route rules and writes next_step.

nodes.name: 07 Start publish_linkedin
nodes.notes: Run dry_run on LinkedIn post. If PASSED: publish. Post result as comment. Continue to X publish regardless of outcome (each platform publishes independently).

nodes.name: Approval Gate publish_linkedin
nodes.notes: Connect this node to an n8n approval/wait mechanism if the gate must pause.

nodes.name: Complete publish_linkedin
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 08 Start publish_x
nodes.notes: Run dry_run on X post/thread. If PASSED: publish. Post result as comment. Continue to Instagram publish.

nodes.name: Approval Gate publish_x
nodes.notes: Connect this node to an n8n approval/wait mechanism if the gate must pause.

nodes.name: Complete publish_x
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 09 Start publish_instagram
nodes.notes: Run dry_run on Instagram caption + image. If PASSED: publish via Meta adapter. Post result as comment.

nodes.name: Approval Gate publish_instagram
nodes.notes: Connect this node to an n8n approval/wait mechanism if the gate must pause.

nodes.name: Complete publish_instagram
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 10 Start close_loop
nodes.notes: Summarise all three publish outcomes. Add label social:published. Close the issue.

nodes.name: Complete close_loop
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Switch route_review
nodes.notes: Routes to the Nexus step selected by the preceding Code node.
